// Command drilllogin 只从真实 HTTP / Robot TCP 观察登录、命名与购买，不装进程内替身。
// 票据只保留在内存；报告只含身份、帧顺序与业务断言，不输出凭据。
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"time"

	"DRILL_MODULE/db"
	apperrors "DRILL_MODULE/internal/errors"
	"DRILL_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"DRILL_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/entitysync"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/frame"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/directory"
)

func must[T any](value T, err error) T {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return value
}
func require(ok bool, format string, args ...any) {
	if !ok {
		panic(fmt.Errorf(format, args...))
	}
}

type client struct {
	conn              transport.Conn
	packets           chan *transport.Packet
	errors            chan error
	seq               uint32
	frames, timeFrame int
	now               *pb.ServertimeNowPush
	decoder           *entitysync.Decoder
	state             *db.PlayerDao
	stop              func() bool
}

func connect(ctx context.Context, endpoint, ticket string) *client {
	c := &client{conn: must(transport.DialPlayerTCP(ctx, transport.Config{Endpoint: endpoint, DialTimeout: 5 * time.Second})), packets: make(chan *transport.Packet, 128), errors: make(chan error, 1), seq: 1}
	c.decoder, c.state = entitysync.NewDecoder(frame.Limits{}), db.NewPlayerDao()
	c.stop = context.AfterFunc(ctx, func() { _ = c.conn.Close() })
	go func() {
		for {
			p, err := c.conn.ReadPacket()
			if err != nil {
				c.errors <- err
				return
			}
			select {
			case c.packets <- p:
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return
			}
		}
	}()
	auth := transport.AuthPacket(ticket)
	auth.Seq = c.seq
	require(c.conn.WritePackets([]*transport.Packet{auth}) == nil, "write auth")
	ack := must(c.next(ctx))
	require(ack.MsgID == 0 && ack.Seq == c.seq && len(ack.Payload) == 0, "invalid auth ACK")
	return c
}
func (c *client) close() { c.stop(); _ = c.conn.Close() }
func (c *client) next(ctx context.Context) (*transport.Packet, error) {
	select {
	case p := <-c.packets:
		c.frames++
		if p.MsgID == msgid.MsgSelfSync {
			decoded := must(c.decoder.Decode(p.Payload))
			for _, object := range decoded.Objects {
				for _, component := range object.Components {
					require(c.state.ApplySync(component.Update.Payload.BytesCopy()) == nil, "apply Player self sync")
				}
			}
		}
		if p.MsgID == msgid.MsgServertimeNow {
			c.now = must(pb.UnmarshalServertimeNowPush(p.Payload))
			c.timeFrame = c.frames
			checkTime(c.now)
		}
		return p, nil
	case err := <-c.errors:
		return nil, err
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, ctx.Err()
	}
}
func (c *client) call(ctx context.Context, id uint32, raw []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	c.seq++
	if err := c.conn.WritePackets([]*transport.Packet{{MsgID: id, Seq: c.seq, Payload: raw}}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for {
		p, err := c.next(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if p.MsgID == id && p.Seq == c.seq {
			return p.Payload, nil
		}
		require(p.Seq == 0, "unexpected response id=%d seq=%d", p.MsgID, p.Seq)
	}
}
func (c *client) status(ctx context.Context, needCreate bool) {
	for {
		p := must(c.next(ctx))
		if p.MsgID == msgid.MsgEnterStatus {
			s := must(pb.UnmarshalEnterStatusPush(p.Payload))
			require(s.Code == 0 && s.NeedCreate == needCreate, "EnterStatus = %+v, need_create=%t", s, needCreate)
			return
		}
	}
}
func (c *client) create(ctx context.Context, name string) *pb.EnterCreateResponse {
	return must(pb.UnmarshalEnterCreateResponse(must(c.call(ctx, msgid.MsgEnterCreate, must(pb.MarshalEnterCreateRequest(&pb.EnterCreateRequest{Name: name}))))))
}
func (c *client) enter(ctx context.Context, first bool) {
	before := c.frames
	r := must(pb.UnmarshalEnterGameResponse(must(c.call(ctx, msgid.MsgEnterGame, must(pb.MarshalEnterGameRequest(&pb.EnterGameRequest{}))))))
	require(r.Code == 0 && r.First == first, "EnterGame = %+v, first=%t", r, first)
	// 在无故障本机演练中要求钩子实际推送且先于应答；不把尽力推送提升为产品的可靠交付契约。
	require(c.timeFrame > before && c.timeFrame < c.frames, "ServertimeNow absent before EnterGame response: before=%d time=%d response=%d", before, c.timeFrame, c.frames)
	fmt.Printf("{\"event\":\"enter\",\"first\":%t,\"time_frame\":%d,\"response_frame\":%d}\n", first, c.timeFrame, c.frames)
	synced := must(pb.UnmarshalServertimeSyncResponse(must(c.call(ctx, msgid.MsgServertimeSync, must(pb.MarshalServertimeSyncRequest(&pb.ServertimeSyncRequest{ClientTick: 47}))))))
	require(synced.Code == 0 && synced.ClientTick == 47, "ServertimeSync = %+v", synced)
	checkTime(synced.Time)
}
func checkTime(now *pb.ServertimeNowPush) {
	require(now != nil && now.DayStartUnixMilli <= now.NowUnixMilli && now.NextResetUnixMilli > now.NowUnixMilli && now.Day > 0 && now.Zone == "UTC", "invalid server time: %+v", now)
}

// 回执与实际可见状态分别核对；冷启动后只恢复了回执、却漏掉钱包/背包/名字也必须失败。
func (c *client) waitState(ctx context.Context, name string) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	for {
		if c.state.GetWallet() != nil && c.state.GetBag() != nil && c.state.GetProfile() != nil {
			held, _ := c.state.GetBag().GetItems(1001)
			if c.state.GetWallet().GetCoins() == 90 && held == 1 && c.state.GetProfile().GetName() == name {
				return
			}
		}
		if _, err := c.next(ctx); err != nil {
			panic(fmt.Errorf("self sync did not converge to coins=90 held=1 name=%s: %w", name, err))
		}
	}
}
func (c *client) buy(ctx context.Context) {
	r := must(pb.UnmarshalShopBuyResponse(must(c.call(ctx, msgid.MsgShopBuy, must(pb.MarshalShopBuyRequest(&pb.ShopBuyRequest{GoodsID: 1, Count: 1, Key: "purchase-1"}))))))
	require(r.Code == 0 && r.Balance == 90 && r.Cost == 10 && r.ItemID == 1001 && r.Held == 1, "purchase/replay = %+v, want balance=90 held=1", r)
}
func (c *client) rename(ctx context.Context, name string) {
	r := must(pb.UnmarshalNamingRenameResponse(must(c.call(ctx, msgid.MsgNamingRename, must(pb.MarshalNamingRenameRequest(&pb.NamingRenameRequest{RequestKey: "rename-1", Name: name}))))))
	require(r.Code == 0 && r.Name == name, "rename/replay = %+v", r)
}

func post(ctx context.Context, base, path string, body any, result any) {
	raw := must(json.Marshal(body))
	req := must(http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, base+path, bytes.NewReader(raw)))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response := must(http.DefaultClient.Do(req))
	defer response.Body.Close()
	raw = must(io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 1<<20)))
	var verdict struct {
		OK     bool
		Code   int32
		Reason string
	}
	require(json.Unmarshal(raw, &verdict) == nil && response.StatusCode == http.StatusOK && verdict.OK, "portal %s: status=%d code=%d reason=%s", path, response.StatusCode, verdict.Code, verdict.Reason)
	require(json.Unmarshal(raw, result) == nil, "decode portal %s", path)
}

func ticket(ctx context.Context, portalA, portalB, identity string, sid int) string {
	var logged struct {
		AccountTicket string `json:"account_ticket"`
	}
	post(ctx, portalA, "/portal/login", map[string]any{"channel": "dev", "open_id": identity, "credential": "dev-recipe-local"}, &logged)
	var listed struct {
		Servers []struct {
			ServerID int `json:"server_id"`
		}
	}
	// A 签发、B 校验并选服：两个真实 account 进程共享正式 Redis 状态。
	post(ctx, portalB, "/portal/servers", map[string]any{"account_ticket": logged.AccountTicket}, &listed)
	found := false
	for _, s := range listed.Servers {
		found = found || s.ServerID == sid
	}
	require(found, "server %d absent", sid)
	var entered struct {
		Ticket          string
		ServingServerID int `json:"serving_server_id"`
	}
	post(ctx, portalB, "/portal/enter", map[string]any{"account_ticket": logged.AccountTicket, "server_id": sid}, &entered)
	require(entered.Ticket != "" && entered.ServingServerID == sid, "portal serving server mismatch")
	return entered.Ticket
}
func waitFile(ctx context.Context, path string) {
	tick := time.NewTicker(50 * time.Millisecond)
	defer tick.Stop()
	for {
		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
			return
		}
		select {
		case <-tick.C:
		case <-ctx.Done():
			panic(ctx.Err())
		}
	}
}

func main() {
	defer func() {
		if err := recover(); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "FAIL:", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}()
	mode := flag.String("mode", "seed", "seed, resume, hold or collision")
	endpoint := flag.String("endpoint", "", "real player TCP endpoint")
	portalA := flag.String("portal-a", "", "login account replica")
	portalB := flag.String("portal-b", "", "ticket validation account replica")
	identity := flag.String("identity", "", "stable identity within the private project")
	sid := flag.Int("sid", 1000, "serving game")
	ready := flag.String("ready", "", "hold ready barrier")
	release := flag.String("release", "", "restart complete barrier")
	occupied := flag.String("occupied", "", "collision: another player's occupied name")
	createName := flag.String("create-name", "", "create with a released name instead of the identity")
	flag.Parse()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 180*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	c := connect(ctx, *endpoint, ticket(ctx, *portalA, *portalB, *identity, *sid))
	defer c.close()
	fresh := *mode == "seed" || *mode == "collision"
	c.status(ctx, fresh)
	if fresh {
		r := must(pb.UnmarshalEnterGameResponse(must(c.call(ctx, msgid.MsgEnterGame, must(pb.MarshalEnterGameRequest(&pb.EnterGameRequest{}))))))
		require(r.Code == apperrors.ErrEnterNeedCreate.Code(), "uncreated EnterGame = %+v", r)
		if *mode == "collision" {
			rejected := c.create(ctx, *occupied)
			require(rejected.Code == directory.CodeKeyTaken, "occupied name = %+v, want directory key taken", rejected)
			// 占名失败之后仍然没建成，不得发首次金币。
			r = must(pb.UnmarshalEnterGameResponse(must(c.call(ctx, msgid.MsgEnterGame, must(pb.MarshalEnterGameRequest(&pb.EnterGameRequest{}))))))
			require(r.Code == apperrors.ErrEnterNeedCreate.Code(), "failed naming created a player: %+v", r)
		}
		name := *createName
		if name == "" {
			name = *identity
		}
		created := c.create(ctx, name)
		require(created.Code == 0, "EnterCreate = %+v", created)
		c.enter(ctx, true)
		again := c.create(ctx, *identity)
		require(again.Code == apperrors.ErrEnterCreated.Code(), "repeat EnterCreate = %+v", again)
	} else {
		c.enter(ctx, false)
	}
	c.buy(ctx)
	c.buy(ctx)
	c.rename(ctx, *identity+"R")
	c.rename(ctx, *identity+"R")
	c.waitState(ctx, *identity+"R")
	if *mode == "hold" {
		require(os.WriteFile(*ready, []byte("ready\n"), 0600) == nil, "write ready")
		waitFile(ctx, *release)
		probeCtx, stop := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
		raw, err := c.call(probeCtx, msgid.MsgServertimeSync, must(pb.MarshalServertimeSyncRequest(&pb.ServertimeSyncRequest{ClientTick: 47})))
		stop()
		require(!errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded), "old connection state unknown: probe timed out")
		retained := err == nil
		if retained {
			r := must(pb.UnmarshalServertimeSyncResponse(raw))
			require(r.Code == 0 && r.ClientTick == 47, "retained connection response %+v", r)
			checkTime(r.Time)
		}
		result := map[string]any{"event": "restart", "old_connection_retained": retained}
		if err != nil {
			result["old_connection_error"] = err.Error()
		}
		fmt.Println(string(must(json.Marshal(result))))
		c.close()
		c = connect(ctx, *endpoint, ticket(ctx, *portalA, *portalB, *identity, *sid))
		defer c.close()
		c.status(ctx, false)
		c.enter(ctx, false)
		c.buy(ctx)
		c.rename(ctx, *identity+"R")
		c.waitState(ctx, *identity+"R")
	}
	fmt.Printf("PASS: mode=%s identity=%s sid=%d balance=90 held=1 naming=%sR\n", *mode, *identity, *sid, *identity)
}
